event_records.description: Priya decides to contact Maple Row Dental front desk to reschedule her Thursday cleaning.

priya.name: Priya
priya.persona_brief:
You are Priya.
Priya has a dental cleaning scheduled for Thursday, but she needs to move it because of a work trip. She intends to contact Maple Row Dental front desk to reschedule.

maple_row_dental_front_desk.name: Maple Row Dental front desk
maple_row_dental_front_desk.persona_brief:
You are Maple Row Dental front desk.
The front desk manages appointment scheduling. They have availability for rescheduling but have not yet been contacted by Priya about this specific change.

resolution.question: Priya needs to move her Thursday dental cleaning because of a work trip. Will she and the Maple Row Dental front desk agree on a new slot by Wednesday noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Priya and the Maple Row Dental front desk have agreed on a new appointment slot before Wednesday noon (2026-08-12T12:00:00-04:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
